items.title: investingLive Americas market news wrap: Strong US services PMI leads to a big breakdown in bonds
items.summary: US September S&P Global flash services PMI 58.7 vs 56.0 expected US treasury sells $70 billion of 5 year notes at a high yield of 5.033% Iranian president says Iran is open to diplomacy but will defend its interests in Hormuz Iranian official says reopening the Strait of Hormuz was discussed in U.S.
items.summaryZh: 美国9月标准普尔全球闪存服务采购经理人指数为58.7 ，而预期为56.0 ，美国财政部以5.033%的高收益率出售700亿美元的5年期国债伊朗总统表示，伊朗对外交持开放态度，但将捍卫其在霍尔木兹的利益伊朗官员表示，在美国讨论了重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的问题。
items.summaryEn: US September S&P Global flash services PMI 58.7 vs 56.0 expected US treasury sells $70 billion of 5 year notes at a high yield of 5.033% Iranian president says Iran is open to diplomacy but will defend its interests in Hormuz Iranian official says reopening the Strait of Hormuz was discussed in U.S.

items.title: investingLive European session wrap: Brent crude retakes $100 as dollar rises, yields climb and stocks slip
items.summary: Headlines: Oil slips below $100 as US-Iran talks put crude prices and Treasury yields at a crossroads The selloff in oil prices stalls as Trump pours cold water on expectations of an earlier end to the conflict Gold falls back to the major $4,300 support ahead of key US data as traders await new US-Iran developments USD/JPY holds above 157 despite BOJ rate…
items.summaryZh: 头条新闻：随着美伊谈判将原油价格和国债收益率置于十字路口，油价下跌至100 $以下。由于特朗普对冲突提前结束的预期，油价抛售停滞不前。黄金回落至美国主要数据之前的4,300 $支撑位，因交易商等待美伊新发展，尽管日本央行加息，但美元/日元仍高于157美元……

items.title: What are the main events for today?
items.summary: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, we get the Flash PMIs for the major Eurozone economies and the UK. The market focus might now shift to growth, given the aggressive tightening already priced in.
items.summaryZh: 欧洲会议在欧洲会议上，我们获得了欧元区主要经济体和英国的初级采购经理人指数（ PMI ）。鉴于已经定价的激进紧缩政策，市场焦点现在可能转向增长。
